title: Meal Allowance — International Travel
content: Employees travelling internationally on Acme Corp business are entitled to a meal allowance of $75 per day. This allowance covers breakfast, lunch and dinner combined. No itemised receipts are required for claims within the $75 per day limit. Claims above $75 per day require itemised receipts and VP approval. Alcohol is not reimbursable under this allowance. The allowance applies only on days when the employee is outside their home country on business. This is a separate entitlement from domestic travel allowance and cannot be combined.
